articles.title: Renee Slegers exclusive: Going 'back to basics' has loosened Arsenal team following back-to-back wins
articles.summary: Renee Slegers believes something has clicked at Arsenal Women following back-to-back wins over Tottenham and Benfica this week; watch Arsenal vs Aston Villa live on Sunday from 11.30am on Sky Sports+, kick-off 12pm
articles.body:
The Gunners boss' tenure looked in a perilous position barely a week ago when their winless WSL run was extended to five games by salvaging only a draw against newly promoted Birmingham.

That left them 10 points off the league summit six games in with the prospect of a North London derby away to a Spurs side four points closer on the horizon.

It could easily have proved fatal. But a gritty victory at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium was followed up with a more aesthetically pleasing 3-0 win over Benfica in the Women's Champions League on Wednesday.

Slegers does not want to call it a reset. And it is too soon. But she does not hide that she and her squad have gone back to basics to simplify things and cut through the growing noise which had risked becoming deafening over the previous month.

"It was a good game to do that against Tottenham," she told Sky Sports. "It was always to be a fight, we had to go into the duels and the tackles against them and balance that with the finesse and the goals.

"When things aren't going right everyone wants to see what it is and find a solution. We've been really constructive throughout, but there's always a risk you go too far and overanalyse and overthink, both internally and externally.

"The key has been to go back to basics, the fight and the duels and the tactical basics. We needed to turn it around and we've done that now.

"It's positive and we just have to be really humble, because it's taken us a lot of hard work to get here and to get the last two wins. There's not a single game which is easy.

"The foundation in this comeback has been the resilience, grit and fight on the pitch. Something has loosened, which is good.

"The Benfica game was probably the most complete performance we've had this season. Defensively we were solid and created a lot of different opportunities going forward in a variety of ways."

Benfica attempted to become the latest team to stifle Arsenal this season, with the Gunners often finding low blocks their Kryptonite against teams they would otherwise be expected to comfortably beat.

Since the start of last season, they have failed to score more than one goal in six of the 10 games where they have had at least 60 per cent possession.

Wednesday's "complete performance" in Europe saw them not only have plenty of the ball, but do plenty with it, too. Benfica had no answer to the hosts' quick and incisive movement and their 3-0 win could easily have been more.

Hat-trick scorer Alessia Russo revealed after the game the team had been encouraged to take more risks in the final third, something Slegers is delighted has come from the players themselves.

"I believe if you can play on instinct you can make the best decisions and play the quickest football but the squad have said it themselves, too.

"We want to engage and involve them and that was one of the big things coming out of the Spurs review - being brave in and around the box.

"I think it was Alessia saying it herself in a team meeting. If we can create a good structure and put good pressure on we need to be brave in those moments because we are all so good, and you saw that against Benfica.

"When we did things fast, we used the spaces early so that was a real strength from us and we want to carry on like that."

Russo's trio took her to 23 goals in the Women's Champions League, making her the highest-scoring English player in the history of the competition ahead of former Chelsea midfielder Fran Kirby.

She has had difficulties this season, failing to score in any of Arsenal's first four WSL games, but has found her scoring boots for club and country with eight goals in her last six games.

When that pressure was ramping up around the club, and despite her own struggles in front of goal, there was never any doubt in Slegers' mind that she would do anything other than get back to her best.

"She's a consistent factor, a positive factor always," she says. "She's constructive, in the periods where it's been difficult for the team she's always positive, she wants to be strength-based, with herself and others for the team.

"She believes in people and has been such an important factor with the other captains. She's grown in her leadership in those moments. There's so much she brings us and so much more to come."

There remain painful memories about facing Arsenal's next opponents, Aston Villa, with a dominant but wasteful 1-1 draw at the Emirates early last season encompassing that struggle against low blocks which would ultimately see them fall four points short in the title race.

It's easy to say, but coupling the quality of that Benfica performance and with the grit shown to beat Tottenham would at least give Slegers hope that finally that hoodoo may be breakable.

"We talk about stacking humble actions and there was a lot of that against Benfica," she says. "Small and big moments, big things which stood out against Spurs but a lot of small things, too.

"We believe if you continue to do those then we can create the margins and moments we need in games. The team did it really well in those two games and we believe we can bring it on Sunday."

articles.title: Ex-Cheltenham Town women's captain claims club was turned into 'dictatorship'
articles.summary: Emily Owen made the allegations after her departure from Cheltenham Town's women's side was announced this week.
articles.body:
The former captain of Cheltenham Town's women's side has accused "an individual" of turning the club into "a dictatorship where players feel psychologically unsafe".

On Monday, Emily Owen announced she was to depart the Women's National League Southern Premier side after four years, during which she made more than 130 appearances.

However, following the club sharing the news on social media, the defender posted a message to say she had left due to "a lack of an individual's principles and outright failures in processes".

Cheltenham Town Women said while it would not comment on individual cases, it takes all matters relating to the welfare and wellbeing of its players "extremely seriously".

Owen said she "wanted to set the record straight" after hearing of rumours circulating around the reasons for her departure.

"One individual in particular has far too much control within this team, turning the environment into a dictatorship where players feel psychologically unsafe," she said.

She went on to claim three other players had left the club "on moral grounds as boundaries were crossed, that shouldn't be crossed in women's football".

A spokesperson for Cheltenham Town Women said: "Cheltenham Town Women are committed to ensuring that every player, member of staff and volunteer is treated with respect and feels safe, valued and supported within our environment.

"We will ensure that any concerns brought to our attention are treated appropriately, sensitively and in line with all relevant policies and procedures".

articles.title: El nuevo Ferran arrasa en marketing
articles.standfirst: Explotan su lado 'canalla'... aunque cada día le llegan nuevas propuestas. Ahora le invitan a las pasarelas de moda de Milán, París, incluso a la Mostra de Venecia. Se espera un repunte de su nombre en los niños nacidos en 2026
articles.summary: Explotan su lado 'canalla'... aunque cada día le llegan nuevas propuestas. Ahora le invitan a las pasarelas de moda de Milán, París, incluso a la Mostra de Venecia
articles.body: Ferran Torres. El gol del Mundial con España le puso en el gran foco. Su llegada a París (PSG) le abre ahora el mercado del lujo. Madruga a diario, se sumerge en agua gélida, a cuatro grados, y luego ya se toma un café, sin leche, activa el ayuno intermitente... Y a funcionar. La cámara le quiere por ese aire rupturista que destila. Hamburguesas, ropa interior...El mercado busca su lado atrevido, rebelde y 'canalla'. Así es el perfil más íntimo del 'tiburón'. Desde su entorno en la compañía Leaderbrock Sports, que dirige Héctor Peris; y David Rodríguez al frente de TQTK Studios, ordenan a diario la intensa agenda de un futbolista resiliente y cuya imagen optimiza su club, el Paris Saint Germain, que pone su camiseta en su gran escaparate de su tienda en Manhattan. Pero, ¿qué buscan las marcas y por qué Ferran aglutina tanto interés en las redes sociales?. "Es un futbolista diferente, directo, mantiene su fidelidad a su entorno desde que era un chaval en el fútbol valenciano", apunta a Efe su gente más cercana. Las marcas buscan su lado 'malote'. El autor del gol del Mundial 2026 que dio a España el título trabaja en la gestión de su presente y futuro con una compañía con sede en Valencia, que tiene un valor de mercado de 447,58 millones de euros según datos de Transfermarkt. Ocupa la posición número 15 en el ránking mundial de agencias especializadas. Es la primera con capital cien por ciento español. Su anuncio de ropa interior, siendo embajador de Iuman Intimissimi, la firma italiana de lencería, le ha puesto en las vitrinas y marquesinas de medio mundo. La negociación comenzó antes del Mundial de EEUU. Antes del gol y del ¡Oh Ferran!. De hecho, un buen día se puso una camiseta de tirantes blanca y Calvin Klein, emblemática en el sector, le dio un comentario de validación en Instagram a la sesión de fotos realizada para la revista influyente de moda WWD -Women's Wear Daily-. Es decir, a Calvin Klein le gustó su posado con su mítica camiseta de tirantes blanca (Cotton Classics Tank Top), le dio aire pero Ferran ya se había comprometido con su actual patrocinador. El Mundial deja hermosas historias de vida. Su entorno recibe a diario propuestas de toda índole. Ser protagonista del texto de un pasadoble, una de las más 'random'. Y es que el futbolista de Foios (Valencia, 2000), tiene un especial gancho, por ejemplo con los dueños de mascotas. Su cariño por los perros le ha posicionado en un segmento importante en la sociedad, que además le pondera su apuesta por la sostenibilidad y su sinceridad y empatía a la hora de describir sus tiempos complicados con su salud mental. El tiburón, su apelativo futbolero, le abre las puertas del Oceanográfic de Valencia, que ha puesto su nombre a uno de sus tiburones grises (Carcharhinus plumbeus) y en su portfolio nota un cambio. Under Armour, tras la marcha de su embajador Stephen Curry, ha depositado toda su estrategia en Ferran Torres, quien recibe en las últimas semanas ofertas top de famosos fotógrafos para captar su posado. Ferran ha recibido muchos palos, mucha crítica que con el paso del tiempo ha sabido digerir, superar. Llegó un momento en que entendió que un error en el campo de juego no puede condicionar su vida. Ha aprendido a relativizar todo. Y a apostar por proyectos valientes. Como ser la imagen de las hamburguesas Vicio. Bajo el lema, "las burgers van primero", la compañía opta por tapar la cara de Ferran con el producto. Una paradoja. Mientras las redes sociales buscan su rostro, un anunciante le esconde para llamar la atención y buscar más clickeos. Su vida ha cambiado. Ahora le invitan a las pasarelas de moda de Milán, París, incluso a la Mostra de Venecia, donde se posicionan 'influencers y celebrities'. Mantiene su preparador personal en casa, cuida su alimentación con un cocinero doméstico, utiliza la cámara hiperbárica en su domicilio, a diez minutos de la ciudad deportiva del Paris Saint Germain y da importancia a su estilista. Ferran, portada en papel del New York Times y del Wall Street Journal, al día siguiente de ganar el Mundial con España, trabaja el mercado de EEUU y de ahí su presencia post veraniega en agosto, siendo protagonista de su marca deportiva con presencia en programas de 'prime time' televisivo y su lanzamiento ceremonial de la primera bola en un partido de béisbol. Así es Ferran. Dejó el FC Barcelona, confió en Luis Enrique y vive una nueva etapa, mientras su imagen da lustre a la tienda del club en los Campos Elíseos. El Mundial 2010 puso de moda el nombre de Iker. Según últimos datos del INE -Instituto Nacional de Estadística- hay 13.255 personas con Ferran de nombre de pila, con una edad media de 32,9 años, correspondientes al año 2025. Lleida, Barcelona, Valencia y Castellón, las ciudades con más Ferran. El INE actualizará el listado de nombres del 2026 próximamente y se espera un repunte de un nombre que se ha hecho más popular desde que Rodri levantó al cielo de Nueva York la Copa del Mundo de la selección de Luis de la Fuente.

articles.title: Simeone: "Los que consigan salir más rápido de los momentos de dificultad serán los que compitan por ganar"
articles.standfirst: El Cholo no se desvía del 'partido a partido' pese a situarse a sólo dos puntos que le separan del Barcelona y su ventaja de uno sobre el Real Madrid
articles.summary: El Cholo no se desvía del 'partido a partido' pese a situarse a sólo dos puntos que le separan del Barcelona y su ventaja de uno sobre el Real Madrid
articles.body: Simeone compareció ante los medios en víspera de visitar al Levante. Posible liderato. "Seguiremos en nuestra línea de ir partido a partido, necesitamos hacer un partido importante ante un rival que siempre nos cuesta y que en casa son fuertes y tienen claro a qué jugar". Difícil centrarse tras el accidente ferroviario. "Es un momento difícil, hay que estar cerca de las familias que han sufrido pérdidas importantes. Es un momento complejo que hay que afrontar con respeto, espero que se solucionen las cosas a mejor para el futuro". Hjulmand. "Está trabajando, compitiendo con futbolistas como Koke, Barrios y Cardoso que lo hacen muy bien. También Mendoza y Obed que nos pueden ayudar en esa posición. Tiene personalidad, necesitamos su mejor versión, lo veo involucrado para seguir creciendo y mejorando y es el camino para llegar al lugar donde dé lo mejor al equipo". Dos partidos con el Barcelona en 15 días. "Todos los años se ha hecho así, adelantar partidos por la Supercoopa, no lo veo complicado. Es una situación motivada por el calendario tan cargado y nos tocará jugar cuando nos toque". Arnau. "Está trabajando con mucha ilusión, es joven, el salto de donde estaba a donde está no es fácil. Tiene compañeros que compiten por jugar como Lookman, que aunque no está en ese momento que nos dio al llegar, confiamos mucho en él, sabemos lo que nos puede dar. Está en demostrar en los entrenamientos al entrenador su crecimiento para luego tener oportunidades". Árbitros se estrenarán en rueda de prensa. "Espero que hablen bien cuando terminen y que digas todo cosas buenas de lo que sucedió". Momento del equipo. "Es muy complejo llegar al 100%, pero para llegar a donde queremos no nos alcanza ese cien, necesitamos más. Dependerá de cómo gestionamos los cambios, los esfuerzos... Necesitamos hacer un partido importante un rival que en su casa lo hace muy bien, tiene velocidad en la parte ofensiva y un trabajo defensivo colectivo muy bueno". Clasificación cambiante. "No me quiero centrar en otros equipos. Nosotros atravesaremos momentos buenos, malos y regulares porque la vida es así. En el campeonato suceden muchas cosas y los que consigan salir más rápido de los momentos de dificultad serán los que terminen compitiendo por ganar".

articles.title: Max Dowman red card: Mikel Arteta's tough love after dismissal - 'This isn't Disneyland'
articles.summary: Max Dowman was sent off in Arsenal's defeat to Fleetwood Town in the Carabao Cup and Mikel Arteta appeared frustrated as he went down the tunnel; Arteta wants to protect the 16-year-old but said "this is the Premier League, not Disneyland"
articles.body:
Moments before Arsenal exited the competition on penalties to the League Two side, Dowman was sent off for violent conduct for kicking out at Harrison Neal after the Fleetwood defender's strong challenge.

Arsenal appealed the red card but it was rejected meaning the youngster is suspended for the clash with Liverpool on Super Sunday .

As Dowman headed towards the tunnel and past the dugouts, Arteta leaned in and said something to the teenager, which Sky Sports' Paul Merson criticised, saying the Arsenal manager should have put an arm around him.

When asked about whether he agreed with the criticism about his own reaction on Dowman, Arteta said: "I haven't seen the reaction to my reaction.

"Whether that's positive or negative. You need to understand the context, the relationship I have with him and what we discussed before we went out.

"If you see the reaction from my mother and father with me sometimes, you'd say 'you don't like that reaction' but for me it was the best reaction ever as it enabled me to be who I am.

"But you want to see the best and most beautiful reaction. You want to see the reaction of his team-mates when they have to play with 10 men.

"What do you expect? That's the level and that's the reaction. Whether it's right or wrong, that's the reaction. And the reaction when I don't win, I'm ****** off, big time.

"This is the environment and the reality. We are not in Disneyland, we are in the Premier League. We look after him so much but we are also demanding as he need to earn the right to play otherwise what are the rest of the boys going to tell me?"

Arteta: There are no issues between me and Dowman

Arteta said: "My reaction was in the heat [of the moment] and of frustration as I know the consequences for that and especially for Max.

"It's something we discussed just before we went out because it's not the first time it's happened as it happened earlier this month with England.

"It will continue to happen with the way he plays and the way he attracts opponents. We have to be protective of him as he is 16 but also very straight with him about what to expect from him towards the team and the club.

"I had a talk with him yesterday. There are no issues at all. I've done it. That's why I'm so protective of these things and young players as we have all made these mistakes.

"We know how much you can get punished. And what happens next. It's not the first time, so we need to put an end to it very quickly."

Arteta: Dowman needs to control his emotions

Arteta is adamant the club go above and beyond to look after the teenager, but believes he has to balance Dowman's youth with the realities of life at the highest level of football.

Speaking to Soccer Saturday , Arteta said: "If he's here it's because he has the right to be here and he's totally done that with his performances, the way he trains and the way he loves this football club - that's unquestionable.

"We all have to learn from what happened on Tuesday - it was going to help us all of us to be better."

"The relationship it's very difficult to judge, I have three kids, I'm a son as well and the way I've been treated, the thing that I appreciate the most is the truth.

"Try to prepare me, try to nurture me and then let me fly, let me make my own decisions and make sure if it doesn't go right you are next to me and Max certainly has that.

"He needs that at this level as well, total honesty, and at the same time a lot of support.

"I can bet you it's going to happen again - is he going to react the same way? In a different way to be composed and emotionally in control to win a football match - that's it."

articles.title: Guille Súnico, el ejemplo perfecto de Valdebebas que conquistó Los Pajaritos
articles.standfirst: Pasó ocho años en la cantera blanca y ahora, lejos de Valdebebas, ha encontrado en la Copa del Rey una noche para reivindicarse
articles.summary: Pasó ocho años en la cantera blanca y ahora, lejos de Valdebebas, ha encontrado en la Copa del Rey una noche para reivindicarse
articles.body: Hay futbolistas que necesitan jugar para demostrar lo que valen. Otros consiguen demostrarlo incluso cuando no juegan. Guille Súnico pertenece a este segundo grupo. Durante años, el joven guardameta construyó en Valdebebas una reputación que iba mucho más allá de sus condiciones bajo palos. Su profesionalidad, humildad y manera de afrontar las dificultades le convirtieron en un ejemplo dentro de la cantera del Real Madrid. Ahora, en el Numancia, ha encontrado una noche para reivindicarse ante el fútbol español. Súnico llegó a La Fábrica en 2018, con apenas 14 años. Ocho temporadas después, tras pasar por las diferentes categorías inferiores y alcanzar el Real Madrid C y el Castilla, decidió este verano emprender una nueva aventura en Soria. Por el camino, había vivido momentos complicados. La competencia en la portería le cerró las puertas de la continuidad y llegó a encadenar dos años casi sin competir. Pero nunca bajó los brazos. Ni una mala cara, ni un mal gesto. Siempre dispuesto a sumar, animar a sus compañeros y aprovechar cada entrenamiento para seguir aprendiendo. Una actitud que no pasó inadvertida en Valdebebas. Raúl González, que coincidió con él durante su etapa en la estructura madridista, siempre tuvo una magnífica opinión del guardameta. Su forma de entender la profesión, su humildad y hasta el hecho de compaginar el fútbol con una carrera universitaria hablaban de un perfil poco habitual. "Es el ejemplo de canterano perfecto que ponemos siempre a todos los chavales. Esfuerzo máximo, gran compañero… y con una buena cara ante cualquier situación. Si tenía que estar en el banquillo, el primero en animar a todos", recuerdan desde Valdebebas. Su historia llegó incluso a convertirse en una referencia para los demás porteros de La Fábrica. La pasada temporada, el Madrid reunió en Valdebebas a más de 30 guardametas de su cantera en una jornada dedicada a una de las posiciones más exigentes y, a menudo, más invisibles del fútbol. Allí se puso el caso de Súnico como ejemplo. Su paciencia encontró una primera recompensa en Old Trafford, ante el Manchester United, en los cuartos de final de la Premier League International Cup. Cuando llegó su oportunidad, respondió. Pero su mayor reconocimiento ya lo había conseguido mucho antes. Este verano decidió buscar fuera del Real Madrid las oportunidades que no terminaban de llegar. Y el fútbol le tenía preparada una noche especial. En la Copa del Rey, frente al Real Oviedo, Súnico se convirtió en uno de los grandes protagonistas de la clasificación del Numancia. Con 3-3 en el marcador, firmó una intervención decisiva en la prórroga y, en la tanda de penaltis, detuvo los dos primeros lanzamientos del conjunto asturiano. Los sorianos ganaron 4-2 y sellaron su pase a la siguiente ronda. Y ahí estaba Súnico... disfrutando de un camino del que no quiere bajarse.

articles.title: Josh Jacobs explains controversial touchdown celebration is not how it looks
articles.summary: Many thought Jacobs' celebration had something to do with his legal situation
articles.body:
Josh Jacobs had the internet abuzz last night with a controversial touchdown celebration against the Carolina Panthers . The Green Bay Packers running back insists it's not what you think.

After punching in a 1-yard touchdown run in the second quarter, Jacobs put his arms behind his back for a celly many thought looked like handcuffs -- a possible nod to his recent domestic violence arrest and stint on the NFL's commissioner exempt list.

It turns out Jacobs was actually referencing the gospel song Break Every Chain by Tasha Cobbs Leonard.

"Basically, last week, we said the first celebration, when I score, I was going to thank God -- that's what I did last week," Jacobs said . "The second one was going to be Break Every Chain . It's a gospel song. That was going to be the next celebration. It's just a correlation, but like I said, the media [is] going to run with it. They're going to make it something that it wasn't, but it is what it is."

Well, it's hard to blame anyone who thought differently based on how it looked on TV.

Jacobs says the Thursday Night Football cameras cut before the world saw his entire celebration, but regardless, it's not the greatest display of self-awareness.

The 28-year-old returned last week after six weeks on the commissioner exempt list, receiving plenty of boos from Detroit Lions fans, and now has three touchdowns over two games.

articles.title: Moreira: Hazard ‘an inspiration’, Cristiano Ronaldo ‘my favourite player’
articles.summary: Milan winger Diego Moreira says his compatriot Eden Hazard is ‘an inspiration,’ but Cristiano Ronaldo remains his ‘favourite player’ and the ‘greatest’ footb...
articles.body:
Milan winger Diego Moreira says his compatriot Eden Hazard is 'an inspiration,' but Cristiano Ronaldo remains his 'favourite player' and the 'greatest' footballer ever.

Moreira spoke to DAZN on the eve of Saturday's derby della Madonnina.

The interviewer showed him some pictures of his relatives and some of his footballing idols, including ex-Chelsea and Real Madrid star Hazard.

Moreira: Ronaldo the greatest player of all time

BOURNEMOUTH, ENGLAND – OCTOBER 22: Adrien Truffert of Bournemouth controls the ball under pressure from Diego Moreira of AC Milan during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD3 match between AFC Bournemouth and AC Milan at Bournemouth Stadium on October 22, 2026 in Bournemouth, England. (Photo by Ryan Pierse/Getty Images)

Moreira, who joined Milan in a €50m deal last summer, described his compatriot as a "Crack."

"What can I say that you don't already know? A big, talented player, one of the best. Growing up watching players like this only drives you to be better every day, and you know why you do it. It's an inspiration," he added.

"When you see him play, you try to do the same thing. I want to thank him for what he did for football. He was a crazy player."

The following picture was of Cristiano Ronaldo. When Moreira was asked if the Portuguese is his favourite player, he replied: "Yes, by far."

"Why? Because he's just the greatest, an inspiration in football and everything. It's just him. I wanted to be like him, even have the same hairstyle, but it wasn't possible because I've got too much hair.

ZURICH, SWITZERLAND – JANUARY 12: Cristiano Ronaldo of Portugal and Real Madrid receives the 2014 FIFA Ballon d'Or award for the player of the year during the FIFA Ballon d'Or Gala 2014 at the Kongresshaus on January 12, 2015 in Zurich, Switzerland. (Photo by Philipp Schmidli/Getty Images)

"I wanted to follow his path because he's an inspiration and a role model for me; he's football. My favourite player. I just want to say thanks for what you did for football; it was incredible. Thank you for making me believe in myself. He's 42 or 43 years old, and he keeps scoring and playing; he keeps his body in shape. I'm happy I was born in his prime."

Moreira picked No. 7 when he arrived at Milan, the same number as Rossoneri legend Kaká.

"Honestly, I wanted the No. 7 when I arrived, but when I saw it was available, I could change again, and I like the No. 22," Moreira said.

"I think it looks nice on my back. It's an honour. Now it's up to me to show I'll try to follow his path again."

Moreira returned to Milan training earlier this week and is in contention to start in tomorrow's derby against Inter.

"It's one of Europe's biggest derbies. Of course we are excited. I'm looking forward to it," he said.

Moreira also spoke highly of his teammate Adrien Rabiot, another Rossoneri star who has recovered from an injury and will be available against Inter.

ITALY – OCTOBER 18: Adrien Rabiot of AC Milan celebrates scoring his team's second goal with teammate Diego Moreira during the Serie A match between AC Milan and Atalanta BC at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on October 18, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)

"From day one, he's been the one who welcomed me with open arms," Moreira said.

"He's been very nice to me. He speaks French. Me and I are always the last ones in the locker room, so we end up eating together and talking a lot about life and football. We also have a good relationship on the pitch. He's a player I really like."

Moreira, 22, has scored three goals and provided one assist in seven appearances across all competitions this season.

articles.title: "It's a Dream" - Manchester City Winger Allan Elias Reacts to First Senior Brazil Call-Up
articles.summary: Allan Elias is set to done the senior Brazil jersey later in November.Allan, 22, joined Manchester City from Palmeiras on 31 August in a deal worth up to £34...
articles.body:
Allan Elias is set to done the senior Brazil jersey later in November.

Allan, 22, joined Manchester City from Palmeiras on 31 August in a deal worth up to £34 million, signing a five-year contract after making 96 appearances for the Brazilian club across the 2025 and 2026 campaigns.

The forward has played 10 minutes of Premier League football for the Blues so far, coming off the bench in the 3-0 win at Liverpool , whilst also scoring and assisting in a 5-0 Carabao Cup win over Norwich City in September.

Brazil manager Carlo Ancelotti named Allan as one of five uncapped players in his 26-man squad on Thursday, with the Selecao facing Japan on 14 November and Singapore three days later at the National Stadium in Singapore.

Speaking to GE Globo and relayed by Goal , Allan reflected on his first call-up to the senior Brazil squad. "I'm very happy with the moment I'm experiencing," the winger said.

"I believe it's a dream for every kid who grows up watching and being in the football world. It's a dream to be in the Brazil national team, I believe one day this was very distant for me and today I can feel this sensation of being called up, being able to wear the Brazil national team shirt, being able to honour our country, it's very rewarding for me."

The 22-year-old was then asked about his aims for the upcoming international window. "I hope to get there and be able to deliver my best and, God willing, stay there," he added.

Allan started Manchester City's Carabao Cup fourth-round tie with Brighton and Hove Albion on Wednesday night and played 61 minutes, with Enzo Maresca having made changes to his side for the first of two meetings with the Seagulls in four days.

The holders drew 2-2 with Brighton before winning 4-3 on penalties, with Geronimo Rulli saving two spot-kicks in the shootout after five first-team regulars had been given three days off following the defeat at Aston Villa last Saturday.

Allan also played the full 90 minutes of the 5-1 Champions League win over AEK Athens earlier this month, a game in which Phil Foden scored a hat-trick and the Brazilian struck the crossbar from a tight angle on the left side of the penalty area.

Maresca said after that win that he was trying to help Allan adapt to life in England following his move from Palmeiras , and that the forward would receive more minutes gradually as he settles into a squad full of established international players.

Antoine Semenyo has been ruled out for around eight weeks with an injury suffered against Ipswich Town, which has left Maresca with one fewer option in the wide areas during a busy run of fixtures before the winter period.

Allan arrived at the Etihad Stadium in the same window that fellow Brazilian Savinho left Manchester City for Tottenham in a deal worth £85 million, with the forward among several summer signings recruited by director of football Hugo Viana under Maresca.

Allan is joined in the Brazil squad by Manchester City defender Vitor Reis, who has one senior cap, whilst Chelsea forward Estevao Willian and Real Madrid duo Vinicius Junior and Endrick are among the attacking options also selected by Ancelotti.

Ancelotti did not call up any players from Palmeiras or Flamengo, who are competing for the Brazilian Serie A title, and his squad for the final two games of the year includes 15 players under the age of 23.

Manchester City host Brighton and Hove Albion at the Etihad Stadium in the Premier League on Saturday 31 October, before a trip to face Nottingham Forest on 7 November ahead of the international break, when Allan could make his Brazil debut against Japan.

articles.title: Robinson urges Aberdeen to seize Hampden chance
articles.summary: Saturday's Premier Sports Cup semi-final with Rangers would be the perfect place for Aberdeen to ease the tension of a disappointing start to the season, says head coach Stephen Robinson.
articles.body:
Saturday's Premier Sports Cup semi-final with Rangers would be the perfect place for Aberdeen to ease the tension of a disappointing start to the season, says head coach Stephen Robinson.

The Dons head to Hampden on a run of just one win from their past five games.

However, Robinson, who led St Mirren to the trophy last year, takes confidence from his own record and the unity he sees at Pittodrie.

"You haven't got time to feel sorry for yourself, if there is a moment to put it right a semi final at Hampden is that time," he said.

"As a footballer you always get another chance, sometimes as a manager you don't and what a chance it is to go to Hampden, a full house with a big support with us. It is certainly the right place to do it and we believe we can.

"Every semi-final that I've been in with Motherwell and St Mirren, we were not expected to win. So I know how to motivate teams and the staff know how to get teams to believe.

"It's certainly an opportunity. All the pressure will be on Rangers, and the expectation will be on Rangers."

Wednesday's 1-0 home loss to Falkirk ended in a chorus of angry boos and leaves the Dons ninth in the Premiership, three points above the bottom.

"It's a great great group of boys that want to be successful and no-one was hiding away from the fact results haven't been good enough," Robinson said of the post-game talks with his squad.

"The players know it needs to be better and they are all in that together. There are no factions, there are no people going off on their own, everyone wants to turn that around.

"There was a good performance in that as well but ultimately we deserved the criticism we got, we can't get away from that. I deserved the criticism. I don't hide behind that. I don't try and throw players under the bus. We have to respond to that."

Robinson, who joined Aberdeen in March, insists he has "normal conversations" with chief executive Adrian Bevingston and chairman Dave Cormack, when asked if he had sought any assurances from the Pittodrie hierarchy about his position.

Rangers boss Derek McInnes spent close to eight years at Aberdeen and has backed Robinson to succeed, if given time.

"Until you are in this position, you don't realise how difficult things are and the parameters you have to work under, Derek obviously does," said Robinson of those comments.

"I have nothing but total respect for him. He is one of the top managers in the country. Everybody wants time but you don't get given time in football, we are all well aware of that and results are what dictates that."

Robinson handed Kevin Nisbet the captain's armband during the summer and the striker insists the players owe everyone associated with the club a big performance.

"The way the fans acted after the Falkirk game was justified. It wasn't a great performance and the blame and the responsibility stops and ends with the players.

"The gaffer has been battered from pillar to post all season and he has taken a lot of flak for us, but that one during the week was definitely on us.

"We owe the gaffer a performance, we owe the fans a performance and we owe the club a performance."

articles.title: José Alberto: "Llevamos mucho tiempo esperando para jugar un partido como este"
articles.standfirst: "Vamos a tener enfrente a uno de los mejores clubes del mundo", afirma
articles.summary: "Vamos a tener enfrente a uno de los mejores clubes del mundo", afirma
articles.body: El Racing ha solventado este pasado jueves su pase a la siguiente ronda de Copa del Rey al vencer al Ribadesella en tierras asturianas. Pero el plato fuerte de la semana será este próximo domingo a las 16:15 horas en El Sardinero donde los cántabros se enfrentan al Real Madrid. José Alberto es consciente de la importancia del encuentro y la ilusión que hay en la afición: "Llevamos mucho tiempo esperando para jugar un partido como este. Quince años de un recorrido del club difícil, jugando contra equipos más humildes, en campos como el de ayer en Ribadesella. Nos ilusiona mucho, nos responsabiliza, pero con la tranquilidad de saber cómo afrontarlo y saber que es un partido más". El técnico racinguista dejaba claro el potencial del Real Madrid, ' "Vamos a tener enfrente a uno de los mejores clubes del mundo, con jugadores extraordinarios, muy bien dirigidos y que están en un buen momento de la temporada". José Alberto es consciente del nivel de Mourinho como entrenador: '"Los equipos de Jose -Mourinho- se caracterizan por ser muy competitivos. La calidad está fuera de toda duda, con las estrellas mundiales que tiene. No sólo Mbappé. Son jugadores brillantes y que va a ser una pasada tenerlos enfrente". Aunque el Madrid es uno de los mejores equipos del mundo, José Alberto confía en las posibilidades del Racing: '"Vamos a intentar mantener nuestro estilo y si lo hacemos, estaremos más cerca de la victoria. Vamos a ser valientes, que no significa ser descerebrados. Tenemos que ser equilibrados". El Racing cuenta con la única baja de Jorge Salinas por sanción por lo que su puesto en el lateral izquierdo será ocupado por Aarón Martín.

articles.title: Pellegrini: "En Málaga pasamos tres años inolvidables"
articles.standfirst: El técnico del Betis comparece en la previa del partido de mañana en La Cartuja
articles.summary: El técnico del Betis comparece en la previa del partido de mañana en La Cartuja
articles.body: El Betis afronta una nueva jornada con el objetivo de volver a sumar de tres en tres en La Cartuja, después del empate ante el Celta. Manuel Pellegrini ha comparecido en sala de prensa y ha explicado su decisión de que el encuentro de la primera ronda de la Copa ante el Navalcarnero, suspendido en señal de duelo y respeto a las víctimas del accidente ferroviario de Toledo, se dispute el próximo jueves 12 de noviembre durante el próximo parón de selecciones. "Una vez que se suspendió el partido era mejor aplazarlo a esa semana de parón de selecciones que jugarlo el jueves jugando el sábado y el miércoles Champions. A veces esa semana uno busca rivales para amistosos y era la mejor fecha para jugar ese partido aunque puedan faltar algunos futbolistas", dijo. En cuanto a nombres propios descartó de la convocatoria frente al Málaga a Junior Firpo pese a que avanza en su recuperación. "Todavía los médicos estiman que debe esperar unos días", señaló. Por contra, Antony se ha ido recuperando de un proceso vírico y sí estará entre los citados para el partido de mañana. Confianza en Parrott. "Entrena siempre muy bien. Si no estuvo en el once el otro día fue por distintos motivos. Después entró. Está en condiciones de volver a retomar su posición". Partido especial. "Sin lugar a dudas que fueron tres años en Málaga inolvidables. Es parte del pasado. Le tengo gran cariño a la institución y a la zona. Es parte del pasado y la estima a otro club hay que dejarla a un lado cuando tienes una confrontación. También se reencuentran Isco, Fornals y Diego Llorente. Todos tienen una gran opinión de lo que es el club, pero mañana saldremos desde el principio por los tres puntos". Dani Ceballos. "Ha ido subiendo su rendimiento acorde a lo que esperábamos. Ha estado mucho tiempo sin jugar y ha tenido problemas de preparación por que ha estado entrenando solo. Está en la lista y ya veremos cuál es el once inicial y si le toca participar". Isco y la grave lesión que sufrió en Málaga. "No creo que Isco tenga ningún problema personal con lo que sucedió en el partido amistoso ante el Málaga. Fue una acción fortuita y le tocó tener esa lesión pero de ahí no pasó. Primero vamos a superar el tema del Málaga y luego en el Borussia. Han pasado muchísimos años como pasaron con el Alcorcón. Son partes de la vida deportiva de un técnico y mañana vamos a estar concentrados solo en buscar los tres puntos". Competitividad del plantel. "Exigiendo el máximo a cada uno de los jugadores independientemente del momento en el que jueguen, Tenemos un plantel estructurado con muchos centrocampistas, pero jugamos en tres competiciones. No es un problema sino que es un solución. Los que entran y los que tienen que salir desde el banquillo demuestran por qué juegan. Partido a partido intento poner al mejor equipo en cada uno". Dudas para la Copa. "Si Troy está citado no va a poder jugar. Vamos a ir viendo la evolución de Cucho. Aitor ya está totalmente recuperado, tenemos a Nelson Deossa que también puede participar en su posición si no va convocado. Quedan muchos partidos y ya iremos viendo".

articles.title: Jack Grealish dropped by Everton: The future for ex-England winger
articles.summary: Is it 'now or never' for Jack Grealish after he was dropped by Everton for a breach of club discipline, asks chief football writer Phil McNulty?
articles.body:
When Jack Grealish breezed back into Everton in his white Lamborghini one hour before the end of this summer's transfer deadline, the excitement among supporters and the player himself was clearly evident.

Grealish's previous spell on loan from Manchester City had been cut short by a serious foot injury, but the 31-year-old had produced enough moments of excitement to make his return to the Finch Farm training base a rare moment of joy amid a miserable summer in the transfer market.

When Grealish finally left in the early hours - with the deal done, every autograph signed and every selfie posed for - it was a sort of homecoming for an everyman personality Everton fans had come to regard as one of their own.

This was a move with a lot riding on it - for Everton manager David Moyes, who had been left with only 18 senior players after a botched transfer window, and especially for Grealish, whose exile from City at the start of the final year of his contract confirmed his banishment.

Now, Grealish's future and Everton 's faith in him, has reached a defining moment.

Grealish's exclusion from Everton 's squad before the Carabao Cup tie at home to Newcastle was publicly described as "a breach of club discipline".

Specifically, it was a failure to turn up for training on Monday, leaving the talented maverick - who was Britain's first £100m footballer when he signed for City from Aston Villa in summer 2021 - facing another rebuild in his career.

Everton 's decision to go public before the game with the reasons for Grealish's absence emphasised the seriousness of his transgression.

The fall-out means this now looks increasingly like Grealish's 'now or never' moment, because failure at Everton will surely mark a downward spiral from the top echelons of the Premier League.

Everton do not regard this week's misdemeanour as marking the proverbial 'Last Chance Saloon' for Grealish. Moyes does not have enough players at his disposal to make rapid outcasts of potential game-changers.

But it increases the pressure on the former England forward to win back the faith of fans who love his obvious enjoyment of life and the magic he has shown he can produce.

Moyes will hope it is a harsh lesson learned, because Everton now have even more to play for, given Wembley has suddenly come into view in the Carabao Cup.

BBC Sport believes there have been occasional time-keeping issues with Grealish in the past, but nothing on this scale from a personality regarded as a hard trainer who, in general, keeps himself in good condition.

Grealish has held talks with those in authority at Everton , where it is sure to have been made crystal clear there must be no repeat, certainly not under a strict disciplinarian such as Moyes, and he must now attempt to be rehabilitated back into the squad.

The inevitable decision to punish Grealish, taken at a high level within the club but with input and full support from Moyes, leaves him at the crossroads.

That is especially the case because Everton gave arguably their best performance of the season to beat Newcastle United 3-1 and set up a quarter-final at League Two Fleetwood Town, conquerors of Premier League champions Arsenal in the last round.

And it was done with the more dynamic style of 20-year-old Tyrique George playing on the left flank, which Grealish might have been expected to occupy.

Grealish dropped over 'breach of club discipline' - what now?

Everton cruise past Newcastle to reach EFL Cup quarter-finals

Moyes was guarded after the game and instead preferred to focus on a vital victory.

"You probably know I'm not going to give any details. It's a club decision and I support it. It's something I don't want to speak too much about," he said.

"The one thing about Everton is that they have got real good values. All the players stand behind it and accept the values, on the pitch and off the pitch, and I think the players did a good job.

"It is a small squad, but we are doing our best to keep challenging. We are not accepting any excuses for anything and I think the players are doing a great job. There was a humility about us."

The words were not specifically aimed at Grealish, but they might as well have been from a manager who will have been bitterly disappointed and angry about his transgression.

Moyes and Grealish formed a close relationship from virtually their first moment of contact in August 2025, the latter saying: "As soon as I spoke to the manager, I knew there was only one place that I wanted to go and that was Everton ."

And Grealish, a key figure when Manchester City won the Treble of Premier League, FA Cup and Champions League in 2023, played his part until sustaining a foot fracture that ended his season in Everton 's 1-0 win at his former club Aston Villa in January.

Grealish's happiness with life at Everton was illustrated when he decided against returning to City, continuing his rehabilitation at Finch Farm rather than going back to Etihad Stadium.

Everton weighed up a second loan deal to bring Grealish back carefully, with his injury, finances and - to a certain extent - his character all entering the equation before Moyes decided to move again for a player who insisted Merseyside was the only place he wanted to be.

Moyes was also juggling very limited options as owners The Friedkin Group appeared to back away from serious squad strengthening as they prepared to put the club up for sale.

Grealish's form this season has been underwhelming, failing to score or create an assist in eight appearances - two of those at City before returning to Everton - while his tendency to slow play down is at odds with the usual tempo Moyes requires from his team.

Moyes' fury will have increased because Grealish, who missed Saturday's loss at Arsenal through "illness", is part of a paper-thin squad that simply cannot carry passengers or have players ruling themselves out through needless ill-discipline.

There will be frustration too, as Grealish is a hugely popular within Everton 's dressing room as well as with staff in every area of the club. He has been described as "a lad with a heart of gold, kind and charming, who actually loves being here".

This was illustrated when he recently made a £10,000 donation to a GoFundMe page for Everton fan Leon Skapars, 36, a father of three who has been diagnosed with cancer.

The family are raising money in a search for treatment options, and Skapars' wife Crystal said: "In that moment, Jack gave our whole family something we desperately needed, hope. What he has done for our family is something we will never forget. It makes us feel incredibly emotional."

Grealish also appeared to present awards at the Daily Mirror's 'Pride Of Britain' event recently, saying: "Footballers are classed as heroes - but these are the real heroes."

On Friday, Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca refused to discuss Grealish's actions at Everton , but did praise his character.

Maresca said: "It's not correct to talk about Jack in this moment, first of all because he is an Everton player and secondly because I don't have all the information.

"I still think he is a good guy and has a big heart."

In April, Grealish extended his role as principal ambassador to Special Olympics Great Britain for a further three years, having first joined in 2022.

Grealish marked the occasion by hosting five of the 10 Special Olympics GB athletes who completed the London Marathon at Everton 's Hill Dickinson Stadium, surprising the athletes with a VIP experience, a stadium tour and spending time with them pitchside.

Those at Everton also regard Grealish as one of the first to engage with their community programme at Finch Farm, as well as meeting with the Everton in the Community Down Syndrome team.

Grealish often talks about the inspiration he takes from his sister Hollie, who has cerebral palsy.

He has, however, hit the headlines in less welcome circumstances over the years, and this latest incident ushered in more.

In April, Grealish was pictured asleep at a Manchester rooftop bar surrounded by drinks. It was a scene that is certainly not against the law but was at best unwise, especially with ever-present phone cameras around and the fact he was in rehabilitation from injury.

In March 2020, he was fined by his club Aston Villa and apologised publicly after breaking lockdown guidelines during the pandemic after leaving his house to visit a friend.

In November 2020, he admitted two counts of careless driving relating to two incidents in which a Citroen van and a Mercedes were damaged.

And yet, speak to most people in football - certainly at Everton - and the character references are unfailingly glowing about his outgoing personality and kind-hearted gestures, making his breach of discipline even more painful for his many admirers.

But after this latest setback, Grealish is running out of time and opportunities to justify that continued support.

articles.title: Matarazzo: "Necesitamos una actuación top para ganar en San Mamés, pero este equipo ha rendido en los días señalados"
articles.standfirst: El técnico de la Real augura un encuentro muy complicado en San Mamés contra el Athletic de un Edin Terzic con el que tiene una muy buena relación y al que tiene ganas de ver
articles.summary: El técnico de la Real augura un encuentro muy complicado en San Mamés contra el Athletic de un Edin Terzic con el que tiene una muy buena relación y al que tiene ganas de ver
articles.body: Pellegrino Matarazzo sabe de sobra que su Real Sociedad tendrá que ofrecer su mejor versión este próximo domingo en San Mamés, si quiere tener opciones de llevarse los tres puntos contra un Athletic de Bilbao al que ve muy sólido y con Nico Williams influyendo para bien cuando juega. Matarazzo ya sabe desde que llegó a la Real hace ya 10 meses que la del derbi es una semana especial. “Sí, es una semana diferente, también en que ha sido una semana sin jugar cada tres días, como nos gusta, pero nos viene bien no hacerlo alguna semana para recuperar, algo que nos viene bien para este gran partido. Los jugadores saben de sobra la importancia de un derbi para San Sebastián y Gipuzkoa, pero es importante ser estables en el nivel de motivación para este partido”. Se le ha cuestionado si es de los que cree que en este tipo de partidos no hay favorito. “Sí, estoy de acuerdo, porque la previa no importa en un partido al que los equipos salen al 120%, más en San Mamés, un estadio poderoso en partidos así, pero vamos llenos de confianza, de energía y queremos ganar. ¿Qué la temporada pasada no perdimos? “No sé si el pasado cuenta tanto, el pasado es pasado y los dos equipos vamos a este partido con ganas de crear nuevos momentos, nueva historia…”. Matarazzo ha vivido ya tres derbis oficiales y cree que es un duelo distinto a otros. “Sí, en cuanto a las emociones en la previa, en el buen ambiente que hay entre las dos aficiones, como representan los dos equipos a Euskadi”. El técnico txuriurdin tiene muy claro que su Real debe dar su mejor versión si quiere llevarse los tres puntos de San Mamés. “Para ganar grandes partidos, necesitas grandes rendimientos. Una fortaleza de este equipo ha sido saber rendir los días que necesitas rendir, este domingo necesitamos un partido completo, una actuación top para poder ganar en San Mamés”. Matarazzo ve a Aramburu ya a tope para salir de inicio y ha desvelado la posible baja de Zakharyan. “Sí, sí, Jon Mikel está preparado y, además, súper motivado. El que vamos a ver si llega es Zakharyan, que se torció el tobillo ayer y vamos a ver si puede llegar al domingo, al partido contra el Lyon yo creo que sí”. Pese a la ausencia del ruso, el técnico tiene muchas posibilidades para confeccionar su equipo titular. “Me hace que mi trabajo sea más complicado, pero me gusta estar en esta situación no tener las cosas fáciles. La gente está entrenado muy bien, con muchos jugadores mereciendo jugar de inicio, así que ahora tengo que acertar yo”. El entrenador realista sabe de ese acto en el que Iribar y Kortabarria van a volver a salir al campo con la ilurriña, como hace 50 años. “Estoy al tanto, fue un momento muy especial y poderoso… Es importante reconocer el coraje que Kortabarria e Iribar tuvieron para llevar la bandera al campo en un momento donde era prohibido hablar la lengua vasca, mostrar la bandera. Llevar la bandera al campo muestra la unidad del País Vasco y su orgullo en un momento donde no era permitido. Yo no puedo sentirlo igual, pero cuanto más conozco a los vascos, más entiendo el significado de ese momento”. Matarazzo se reencontrará con Terzic, con el que se midió varias veces en la Bundesliga. “Sí, le conozco a él, hemos jugado en contra, también hemos cenado juntos, nos conocemos bien, pero cambiando el club el partido cambia, porque los jugadores son diferentes, así que es evidente que el partido no va a ser igual. No creo que sea una ventaja para ninguno de los dos el conocernos, pero tengo ganas de verle y hablar con él”. Se le ha pedido que destacase algún futbolista el conjunto rojiblanco. “No quiero hablar de jugadores individuales, pero cuando Nico está en el campo se nota mucho. Peor el Athletic tiene un equipo muy fuerte, que trabaja mucho, que no concede muchos goles, que tiene a Unai Simón, que ha ganado esta semana el premio al mejor portero...”.

articles.title: Celtic: Martin O'Neill vows to 'sort out' striking options ahead of Premiership trip to Falkirk, live on Sky
articles.summary: The Hoops are four points clear at the top of the Scottish Premiership; Camilo Duran is the club's top scorer this season; watch Falkirk vs Celtic on Sunday, live on Sky Sports from 12.30pm
articles.body:
The Hoops started the Scottish Premiership game against Dundee United with three centre-forwards: Callum Osmand, Kasper Hogh and Camilo Duran.

Then, when Celtic were 2-1 down at half-time, O'Neill took off Osmand and Hogh, moved scorer Duran into the middle and brought on wingers Jota and Hasseim Hassan.

Celtic pegged back the visitors to 2-2 to remain four points clear of Rangers at the top of the table but while they are, as usual, in a strong position in the league, they have lost all three of their Europa League games.

After the United game, McGregor said of the three striking positions: "It's not really having a nailed-on profile for each of the positions. The players behave like a winger, or they behave like a striker.

"You can get away with it for a few games but if it's a striker playing as a winger, you are going to get that behaviour a lot of the time.

"You've got enough quality so you can score goals and get away with it. But we have to try to get the team functioning the way it should.

"Then that will alleviate all the other problems that we are encountering, where it becomes a bit basketball, you lose control and spend the next 15 minutes trying to get possession back."

With title rivals Rangers and Hearts involved in Scottish League Cup semi-finals at Hampden Park this weekend, Celtic have the chance to go seven points clear when they travel to Falkirk on Sunday, live on Sky Sports.

O'Neill said: "I've said this to you before, I totally agree that Osmand is actually really a centre forward. I've said it at the press conference, that he is essentially a centre forward who probably would play off somebody strong alongside him.

"Not so sure that he could lead the line on his own. And that Duran is really a centre forward.

"So the players are getting to know each other. It's really as simple as that. So I'm in total agreement with Callum. We'll sort it out.

"We seem to be doing okay domestically, trying to sort it out.

"There's a few players that haven't had a chance. (Jordan) Lotomba hasn't had a chance yet to play. There'll be moments, absolutely. There'll be people in the squad.

"Young (Joel) van den Berg, again, has trained today. And so over the course of the next number of weeks, between now and Christmas, I think everybody will be on the field of play.

"And then it's a matter of establishing, right positions as much as possible.

"Players have played out of position before. Don't know whether it was a big issue when young Osmand came on in the Benfica game and set us alight."

articles.title: Christian Pulisic, AC Milan Agree to New Long-Term Contract Extension
articles.summary: Christian Pulisic is staying with AC Milan for many years to come.
articles.body:
Christian Pulisic is staying with AC Milan for many years to come.

AC Milan announced on Friday it has agreed to a long-term contract extension with Pulisic that runs until 2031.

"I've learned a lot this year, especially from Milan and the fans," Pulisic said in a statement. "The support they showed me, particularly during difficult times, meant something really special to me."

Pulisic's original contract with Milan was set to expire in June 2027. He joined the club in July 2023 on a transfer deal with Chelsea.

The move kicked off a period of success for Pulisic that has made him one of the best wingers in the world. He has 55 combined goals and assists in 106 matches with Milan.

AC Milan has finished in the top five of the final Serie A table in two of Pulisic's first three seasons with the club. The Red and Black are currently fifth in the standings through nine matches so far in the 2026-27 season.

Pulisic missed Milan's first three Serie A matches this season while recovering from the bone bruise and microfracture leg injuries he suffered in the United States' loss to Belgium in the Round of 16 at the World Cup.

Since making his season debut on Sept. 12, Pulisic has two goals and one assist in league play.

Prior to joining AC Milan, Pulisic's club career included stints with Borussia Dortmund and Chelsea. He has also played for the United States since 2016 and has won U.S. Soccer Male Player of the Year four times.

articles.title: Zion Suzuki analysis: How Emi Martinez's Aston Villa replacement now looks like a potential upgrade given his range of skills
articles.summary: Adam Bate examines the numbers behind how goalkeeper Zion Suzuki has impressed everyone at Aston Villa since replacing Emiliano Martinez in the summer. Watch Aston Villa vs Fulham live on Saturday Night Football on Sky Sports Premier League; kick-off 8pm
articles.body:
Suzuki has been superb since joining from Parma in the summer. Not only has Martinez not been as missed as many anticipated, there is growing optimism that in his 24-year-old replacement, Villa have a goalkeeper who has even more facets to his game.

There have been some standout displays already. Suzuki was excellent in the win over Manchester City last time out, ending their 100-per-cent Premier League record under Enzo Maresca. The contrast with Gianluigi Donnarumma at the other end was stark.

While the Champions League winner allowed Nicolas Jackson's decider to go through him, Suzuki pulled off a series of stops, relieved pressure with his claims and looked far more composed with the ball at his feet. Only one of the two looked world class.

Suzuki had been identified by Paris Saint-Germain as a potential long-term replacement for Donnarumma, who left last year. But mooted plans to loan him out to continue his development helped convince the player that the plans at Villa were preferable.

"He is ambitious," explained his manager Unai Emery when asked about Suzuki following that performance against City. "It is very important, his mentality. He is very ambitious himself. He chose to be here with us when we spoke with him about our project."

Suzuki is one of the reasons why fans are excited about Villa's refresh. The challenge given the changes in personnel was always going to be embracing Emery's ideas quickly given that they famously take time to grasp. But the goalkeeper has adapted swiftly.

There are traits that he shares with Martinez. Most notably, Suzuki has caught a cross more often than any other goalkeeper this season - with two exceptions, one of whom is Martinez. He has a similar presence in that penalty area. But there are differences too.

It is Suzuki's work in the build-up that has caught the eye. It had to be a strength because it is so important in Emery's system. "We need one 'keeper first to save us in the goal. But as well we need one 'keeper to try to help us in our build-up," the Villa boss explained.

"In build-up he is a really fantastic player because he can play short, he can understand where to break the opponent's press. He also has good qualities to do long ball and get our players in attack. We are very impressed how he adapted so quickly to the task."

Suzuki does not bait the press quite as much as Martinez did. Nor is he quite so proficient at the angled pass out wide. But he has undoubtedly brought greater variety to Villa's distribution thanks to his extraordinary ability to punch passes long with either foot.

There was an early glimpse of that on his debut against Arsenal. One arrowed Suzuki strike was described by Gary Neville on co-commentary for Sky Sports as "one of the best passes" that he had ever seen. His superior speed and range of pass sets him apart.

Factor in his remarkable reflexes when moving rapidly along his line and his shot-stopping has been a strength too. There is some noise in the goals-prevented data at this early stage of the season but the numbers still suggest that he saved more shots than expected.

Interestingly, the figures for expected goals do not include those openings for the opposition that did not result in shots. In the case of Suzuki, in particular, that is significant because his ability to come off his line and sweep up behind Villa's high line is a major asset.

Suzuki ranks second behind Leeds' James Trafford for the number of sweeper-keeper regains made per 90 minutes, indicative of his ability to snuff out chances before they happen. But for the Villa supporters, Suzuki does not rank second - he is their number one.

He is a symbol of their refresh and still improving. "How he is every day working, every day showing his desires to work strong to get as best as possible, is really fantastic," said Emery. And why what could have been a problem for Villa is starting to look like an upgrade.

articles.title: España reina en el mundo desde la base
articles.standfirst: La Selección Sub-16 española conquista en Bakú el primer Mundial Sub-15 de la historia tras ganar 0-3 a República Checa y sólo le falta el Mundial sub-17 para completar todos los títulos del fútbol formativo español
articles.summary: La Selección Sub-16 española conquista en Bakú el primer Mundial Sub-15 de la historia tras ganar 0-3 a República Checa y sólo le falta el Mundial sub-17 para completar todos los títulos del fútbol formativo español
articles.body: España ha vuelto a subirse al tejado del planeta, y esta vez lo ha hecho empezando por los cimientos. En Bakú, en el estreno absoluto de la Copa Mundial y Festival Sub-15 de la FIFA, la selección que dirige temporalmente David Gordo se proclamó campeona del primer torneo de su especie, un título que nadie había levantado antes y que, por tanto, nadie podrá arrebatarle de la memoria. La Rojita llegó a la final de la categoría A con una hoja de servicios inmaculada: nueve partidos, nueve victorias y treinta y 39 goles. Por el camino había goleado a Grecia en semifinales y a Colombia, dejando siempre la sensación de equipo hecho. Enfrente aguardaba el otro invicto del cuadro, una República Checa que no había llegado hasta allí por casualidad. Los centroeuropeos arrastraban también un pleno de triunfos y un reguero de goles, con dos víctimas de nivel en la mochila: habían eliminado a Italia en octavos y tumbado a Brasil en los penaltis de cuartos. En el Baku Crystal Hall, engalanado para la ocasión, los de Gordo tomaron pronto las riendas, aunque no sin pasar algún apuro que desbarató Leo Rico bajo palos. El ocho contra ocho, jugado en un espacio reducido para lo que están acostumbrados estos chicos, convirtió el partido en un vaivén de ocasiones en el que cualquier descuido se pagaba caro. España, sin embargo, encontró premio a su insistencia en el minuto 12. Tiago Polo, que ya había avisado varias veces, recibió en el costado izquierdo y dibujó con la diestra un disparo colocado que se coló por la escuadra del meta checo. Un golazo para abrir la lata y para firmar la clase de un futbolista que lleva el talento por bandera. El descanso llegó con la Rojita por delante y con la lección aprendida de por qué partía como favorita al oro. Y apenas cuatro minutos después de la reanudación, el guion se inclinó del todo hacia el lado español. Mikel López probó fortuna desde fuera del área con un disparo potente que el portero checo rechazó como pudo, pero el balón suelto llevaba el nombre de Bruno Fernández, que lo empujó casi a placer para el segundo. La sentencia esperó al minuto 31, a nueve del final. Lucas Bernal, un incordio permanente para la zaga checa por su carril zurdo, encaró, dribló y colgó un centro medido al segundo palo, donde apareció Adrián Bielsa para rematar el tercero. A partir de ahí solo faltó que el reloj cumpliera su parte. Cuando lo hizo, España se abrazó a una gesta que mira menos al presente que al porvenir. La generación de 2011 ha conquistado el primer trofeo de esta competición y, de paso, uno de los que le quedaba por abrochar al fútbol base español.

articles.title: Luto en el Leganés: una de las fallecidas en el accidente de Urda es madre de la jugadora Cristina Chao
articles.standfirst: Su padre está ingresado con heridas de importancia ya que viajaba junto a su mujer en uno de los trenes
articles.summary: Su padre está ingresado con heridas de importancia ya que viajaba junto a su mujer en uno de los trenes
articles.body: El Leganés está de luto tras el fallecimiento de la madre de Cristina Chao, una de sus jugadoras del primer equipo femenino, en el accidente de Urda (Toledo). El Leganés ha emitido un comunicado oficial en el que manda todo su apoyo a su futbolista y a su familia: "Todo el C.D. Leganés quiere mandar su cariño y su apoyo a nuestra jugadora del primer equipo femenino, Cristina Chao Barba, y a toda su familia tras el fallecimiento de su madre en el trágico accidente de tren. En estos momentos tan difíciles, queremos estar especialmente cerca de Cristina y de su hermana, acompañándolas y mandándoles toda nuestra fuerza. También queremos enviar nuestros mejores deseos a su padre, que permanece ingresado recuperándose de las lesiones sufridas. Esperamos de corazón que pueda recuperarse muy pronto. Este fin de semana, todos nuestros equipos guardarán un minuto de silencio antes de sus partidos, como muestra de cariño, respeto y apoyo a la familia. Un homenaje que también tendrá lugar el próximo 7 de noviembre en el Ontime Butarque. Cristina, estamos con vosotras. Un abrazo enorme y todo nuestro cariño para toda la familia".

articles.title: Lahm: "Creo que Kane preferiría ganar la Champions al Balón de Oro"
articles.summary: Se avecina 'Klassiker' y quién mejor que Philipp Lahm (Múnich, 1983) para hacer balance en una 'mesa redonda' organizada por la Bundesliga. El exinternacional alemán analiza el gran duelo del fútbol alemán con el Bayern líder y el Borussia Dortmund, segundo, empatados a puntos en la cabeza de la tabla.
articles.body: Se avecina 'Klassiker' y quién mejor que Philipp Lahm (Múnich, 1983) para hacer balance en una 'mesa redonda' organizada por la Bundesliga. El exinternacional alemán analiza el gran duelo del fútbol alemán con el Bayern líder y el Borussia Dortmund, segundo, empatados a puntos en la cabeza de la tabla. Pregunta. ¿Qué valor tiene para el fútbol alemán que Harry Kane haya ganado el Balón de Oro? Respuesta. Es muy saludable para el fútbol alemán que alguien de la Bundesliga haya ganado el Balón de Oro. Supone una gran motivación para los jóvenes que empiezan a jugar al fútbol. En Alemania tenemos una situación excepcional porque la base y el fútbol profesional están muy conectados. Cada jugador empezó jugando en el equipo de su pueblo, en su pequeña comunidad, hasta que se convirtió en profesional. P. ¿No cree que en su época Ribéry y Lewandowski pudieron ganar el Balón de Oro? R. Creo que Kane preferiría ganar la Champions al Balón de Oro. Todos los jugadores sabemos lo importante que es el colectivo para el éxito. Tuve la oportunidad de ganar el Balón de Oro, pero para mí nunca fue algo tan impotante como el equipo porque es un premio individual. Puede que sea más importante para los delanteros que para los defensas. Seguro que Ribéry está contento de que Kane haya ganado el Balón de Oro... pero seguirá enfadado por no haberlo ganado él [ríe]. P. ¿Qué hace tan especial 'Der Klassiker' entre Bayern y Borussia Dortmund? R. Creo que en los últimos 30 años ha ido ganando poso como Clásico. El Borussia Dortmund, poco a poco, se fue acercando al Bayern. Cuando yo jugaba consiguieron ganar dos Ligas consecutivas. Esta vez, encima es el primero contra el segundo, por eso es el el mejor partido que se puede ver ahora en Alemania. P. ¿Qué es lo que más valora del trabajo de Kompany? R. Lo más importante es saber cómo quieres jugar. Tener claro el sistema. Y luego repetir. Kompany jugó los ocho primeros partidos de la pasada temporada con el mismo once y luego, en los partidos más importantes, puso esa misma alineación. Eso te da claridad. Y se demuestra también en el Barcelona, en el PSG, en la selección española... Pero lo que más me impresiona de Kompany es la paz que ha traído al club y al equipo. P. ¿Qué opina de Michael Olise? R. Es un excelente jugador. Puede crear muchas cosas en el campo. No sólo en el Bayern, sino también en el equipo nacional francés durante los últimos meses. Es un candidato a ganar el Balón de Oro. Es posible ganar el Balón de Oro jugando en el Bayern, lo hemos visto este año. P. ¿Cómo cree que le puede afectar al Bayern la baja de Luis Díaz? R. La agresividad y la actitud defensiva que aporta Luis Díaz son muy importantes. Todos queremos ver a los jugadores 'top' sobre el campo. Es una pena que un jugador de su nivel no esté disponible. P. ¿Cree que el Bayern puede ganar la Champions? R. Claro que puede. Tengo que ver cómo Kompany se adapta y encaja el equipo porque, a menudo, juega con sólo 1-2 defensas y eso supone un riesgo contra los mejores equipos, caso de Arsenal, PSG, Real Madrid... P. ¿Cuál cree que es el secreto de la longevidad de su excompañero Manuel Neuer? R. La felicidad y la alegría de jugar con un equipo y estar en ese deporte. Y la motivación. Parece que Manu todavía tiene todo eso. Pero sólo él puede decidir por sí mismo. No sé cuánto tiempo seguirá jugando. Es un ejemplo, un líder. P. ¿Cómo valoras los primeros movimientos de Jürgen Klopp? R. Con Jürgen Klopp tienes un seleccionador que trae mucha experiencia. En el primer parón quería ver muchos jugadores. Tenemos que esperar a ver qué ocurre en los partidos de noviembre, pero lo importante es que, cuando llegó al cargo, anunció lo que quería hacer y lo que iba a hacer con claridad. P. ¿Cómo cree que ha cambiado el fútbol desde que se retiró? R. Cuando miro cómo en España los jugadores quieren jugar veo que están entrenados específicamente. En Alemania tenemos una gran infraestructura, tenemos dinero, tenemos estadios llenos, tenemos talentos... Estamos en una buena situación, pero el equipo no es tan exitoso en estos momentos. Estamos perdiendo este concepto: '¿Cómo queremos jugar fútbol en Alemania?': cómo defiendo, cómo me muevo en mediocampo, cómo voy a los duelos... Creo que necesitamos más especialistas... en lugar de un jugador que juegue en cuatro posiciones. P. ¿Cómo de importante fue ser capitán del Bayern? R. Lo más importante es cómo representas al equipo en cada situación. Como capitán, como persona de liderazgo, es importante conocer a tus compañeros. No te puedes comunicar con cada uno de la misma forma. Hoy en día, la situación es diferente por la globalización y las redes sociales, por eso es importante tener un grupo amplio de capitanes, formado por cinco jugadores, que caminen en la misma dirección. P. ¿Qué recuerdos destacaría de su época como jugador en los 'Klassiker'? R. El peor fue la 2011-12, cuando jugamos en Dortmund tres días antes de la final de la Champions y, a pesar de jugar bastante bien, perdimos la Bundesliga. Ese mismo año perdimos la final de Copa 5-2 y también perdimos la final de Champions. Pero también tengo grandes recuerdos, como la final de Champions ganada al Dortmund en 2013. Luego también les ganamos la Supercopa. P. En Argentina hay un debate muy fuerte entre Messi y Maradona. ¿Con quién se queda? R. Antes de nada, ambos eran figuras excelentes, y realmente colocaron un listón muy alto. Su carácter es diferente, definitivamente diferente. En mi época, Messi fue el jugador más importante durante más de 15 años junto a Cristiano Ronaldo.

articles.title: Nico Serrano gana confianza tras su partido copero
articles.standfirst: El extremo navarro fue titular y marcó un gol ante el Prat
articles.summary: El extremo navarro fue titular y marcó un gol ante el Prat
articles.body: Nico Serrano compareció ante los medios de comunicación tras su titularidad y su gol frente al Prat en la plácida eliminatoria copera, resuelta con un contundente 1-6 a favor de los rojiblancos. El extremo navarro analizó el encuentro, admitiendo que en el vestuario son plenamente conscientes de la dificultad que entrañan siempre este tipo de duelos a partido único, a pesar de lo abultado del marcador final. Sobre su actuación sobre el verde, Serrano se mostró satisfecho con su rendimiento defensivo: "En la primera parte he estado muy cómodo y creo que he cumplido haciéndolo bien de lateral izquierdo". En ese sentido, el navarro no ocultó su ambición, subrayando que "siempre quiero jugar lo máximo posible y sumar sobre el campo". Al ser preguntado por su falta de continuidad en el esquema titular, dejó claro su compromiso con el grupo. “Estoy acostumbrado a tener que estar preparado siempre para cuando llega la oportunidad”. Respecto al siempre exigente factor mental, confesó con sinceridad que «cuando tienes pocos minutos, siempre sales al campo un poco más tenso, queriendo demostrar todo en muy poco tiempo». Por otro lado, Nico Serrano quiso poner en valor la inercia positiva que atraviesa el Athletic, un impulso anímico fundamental de cara al inminente derbi. Hay que recordar que los rojiblancos se dieron un festín goleador ante el Getafe y también lo hicieron ante el Prat en Copa. Fiel a su perfil trabajador, evitó reclamar más protagonismo a Edin Terzić: “Yo me limito a hacer mi trabajo cada día, quiero seguir ayudando al equipo y, los minutos que Terzić decida darme, voy a salir a muerte para aprovecharlos”.
